integrity: The proof uses the exact finite support-functional geometry of the regular octagon, the harmonic-mean/arithmetic-mean inequality, and Hölder equality. The bundled checker independently enumerates the finite support data and samples the scalar profile; its grids are supplementary rather than substitutes for the analytic proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the regular octagonal norm and to the harmonic-mean member of the Amini–Harandi–Rahimi family. It does not classify other homogeneous means or other regular polygons, and it does not concern the later skew-parameterized family.
title: Harmonic Amini–Harandi–Rahimi profile of the regular octagonal plane
